postprocessing.background: Resize/crop to 1280x720 and encode still WebP, quality 88.
postprocessing.portrait: Preserve alpha; fit into 320x320 then centre on a transparent 384x384 canvas for circular-crop margins. Copy identical PNG into all four portrait slots.

Use case: illustration-story. Production asset for a personal anime-themed chat app. Polished colour anime illustration, crisp expressive linework, restrained cel shading and subtle painterly atmosphere; consistent cohesive series. Faithful character design from My Hero Academia, original pose and composition. No added text, lettering, logos, watermark, border, collage, panel divisions or interface elements.
Asset type: desktop chat background, wide 16:9 landscape, preferably 1920x1080, at least 1280x720, opaque.
Subject: Izuku Midoriya / Deku: youthful determined face, freckles on both cheeks, large green eyes, messy dark green hair with black shading. Classic green hero suit, white/silver neck respirator resting below his face, black details, red utility belt. Keep face uncovered. Green/cyan One For All sparks restrained around his arm.
Composition: ONLY ONE Deku, medium-long or waist-up action portrait at the far right quarter, fully inside the frame with head margin. His face and upper body are on the right, no close-up giant face. The middle 55% and left half are dark, calm and low-detail negative space for existing chat UI; bottom region subdued. Background: a quiet rooftop overlooking an out-of-focus city at blue hour, deep ink-navy shadows, a few green/cyan lights (#00ff00 and #00ffff) toward edges. Heroic but calm, controlled small energy arcs near his right-side position. Keep bright effects and focal detail out of the central chat column. This is artwork only; do not draw the chat UI.
